title: Update Documentation Result
description: Return of the update-documentation agent when its prompt gives paths: the pb key it was given, the proposed commit subject and the docs it changed, which pb checkpoint reads. An empty list means no change

pb_key.description: The key from the prompt, copied exactly

commit_subject.description: Proposed commit subject line, or an empty string when nothing changed

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths of files the agent modified
